---
title: "Interactive Comparison: Strikeouts vs. Hard-Hit Rate"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load player-season datasets
hitters_hard_hit <- read_csv("data/all_hitters_hard_hit.csv")
pitcher_seasons <- read_csv("data/pitcher_seasons.csv") |>
  left_join(
    Lahman::People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast) |> mutate(name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast)),
    by = "playerID"
  )

# Add horizontal jitter for individual points so they don't overlap completely
set.seed(42)
hitters_jittered <- hitters_hard_hit |>
  mutate(year_jitter = year + runif(n(), -0.25, 0.25))

pitchers_jittered <- pitcher_seasons |>
  mutate(year_jitter = yearID + runif(n(), -0.25, 0.25))

# Calculate annual league averages
yearly_hh <- hitters_hard_hit |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(avg_hard_hit = round(mean(hard_hit_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1))

yearly_k9 <- pitcher_seasons |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(avg_so9 = round(mean(so9), 2))
```

## Interactive Era Comparison (2005–2025)

Use the filter buttons at the top to toggle between individual player points and clean league-average trends.

```{r}
#| label: plot-interactive-comparison
plot_ly(height = 480) |>
  # Hitter player-seasons (left axis)
  add_markers(
    data = hitters_jittered,
    x = ~year_jitter,
    y = ~hard_hit_pct,
    name = "Hitter Seasons",
    marker = list(color = "#e41a1c", opacity = 0.2, size = 3.5),
    text = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b> (", year, ")<br>Hard-Hit Rate: ", hard_hit_pct, "%"),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  # Pitcher player-seasons (right axis)
  add_markers(
    data = pitchers_jittered,
    x = ~year_jitter,
    y = ~so9,
    yaxis = "y2",
    name = "Pitcher Seasons",
    marker = list(color = "#377eb8", opacity = 0.2, size = 3.5),
    text = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b> (", yearID, ")<br>K/9: ", round(so9, 2)),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  # Annual league average lines
  add_lines(
    data = yearly_hh,
    x = ~year,
    y = ~avg_hard_hit,
    name = "Avg Hard-Hit %",
    line = list(color = "#b30000", width = 3),
    text = ~paste0("<b>", year, " League Avg</b><br>Hard-Hit Rate: ", avg_hard_hit, "%"),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  add_lines(
    data = yearly_k9,
    x = ~yearID,
    y = ~avg_so9,
    yaxis = "y2",
    name = "Avg K/9",
    line = list(color = "#08519c", width = 3),
    text = ~paste0("<b>", yearID, " League Avg</b><br>K/9: ", avg_so9),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "<b>Player-Season Hard-Hit Rate vs. Strikeout Rate</b> (2005–2025)",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = 0.98,
      font = list(size = 15)
    ),
    margin = list(t = 80, b = 60, l = 60, r = 60),
    xaxis = list(title = "Year", dtick = 5, gridcolor = "#f0f0f0"),
    yaxis = list(
      title = list(text = "Hard-Hit Rate (%)", font = list(color = "#b30000", size = 12)),
      ticksuffix = "%",
      gridcolor = "#f0f0f0"
    ),
    yaxis2 = list(
      title = list(text = "Strikeouts per 9 Innings (K/9)", font = list(color = "#08519c", size = 12)),
      overlaying = "y",
      side = "right",
      showgrid = FALSE
    ),
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#2c3e50", font = list(color = "white")),
    # Interactive view switcher buttons
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "buttons",
        direction = "right",
        x = 0.5,
        xanchor = "center",
        y = 1.10,
        buttons = list(
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", list(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE)), label = "Show All"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", list(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE)), label = "Averages Only"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", list(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)), label = "Hitters Only"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", list(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)), label = "Pitchers Only")
        )
      )
    ),
    # Shaded backgrounds for pre-Statcast and post-Statcast eras
    shapes = list(
      list(
        type = "rect",
        x0 = 2004.5,
        x1 = 2014.5,
        y0 = 0,
        y1 = 1,
        yref = "paper",
        fillcolor = "rgba(55, 126, 184, 0.06)",
        line = list(width = 0),
        layer = "below"
      ),
      list(
        type = "rect",
        x0 = 2014.5,
        x1 = 2025.5,
        y0 = 0,
        y1 = 1,
        yref = "paper",
        fillcolor = "rgba(228, 26, 28, 0.06)",
        line = list(width = 0),
        layer = "below"
      ),
      list(
        type = "line",
        x0 = 2014.5,
        x1 = 2014.5,
        y0 = 0,
        y1 = 1,
        yref = "paper",
        line = list(dash = "dash", color = "#777777", width = 1.5)
      )
    ),
    annotations = list(
      list(
        x = 2009.5,
        y = 0.98,
        yref = "paper",
        text = "<b>Pre-Statcast Era</b>",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(color = "#377eb8", size = 12)
      ),
      list(
        x = 2020,
        y = 0.98,
        yref = "paper",
        text = "<b>Statcast Era (2015+)</b>",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(color = "#e41a1c", size = 12)
      )
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.16)
  ) |>
  config(responsive = TRUE)
```

By displaying both sets of player-seasons together, we can observe how the entire distribution of player performances shifted upward along with the introduction of Statcast in 2015.
